stages.name: Monorepo Scaffolding, Governance & Cross-Platform CI/CD Engine

subphases.title: Dependency & Toolchain Hardening
verification_criteria: Assert system toolchain versions (Flutter SDK >= 3.24, Dart >= 3.5, OpenJDK 17, Git, PowerShell 7+)
Configure environment variable validation and generate .env.template with strict schema parsing

subphases.title: Modular Directory Archetype & Monorepo Configuration
verification_criteria: Scaffold Domain-Driven Design (DDD) directory structure (core/, domain/, data/, presentation/, platform/)
Initialize monorepo boundaries, .gitignore, .gitattributes (enforcing LF line endings across platforms)

subphases.title: PowerShell Orchestration Engine (bootstrap-*.ps1)
verification_criteria: Author scripts/bootstrap-init.ps1 to initialize directories, state, and git hooks
Author scripts/bootstrap-subphase.ps1 to enforce transition states and automate atomic Git commits
Author scripts/bootstrap-verify.ps1 to compute subphase completion metrics and print visual CLI progress trees

phases.name: State Machine Protocol & Engineering Rules Contract

subphases.title: Project State Schema (.project_state.json)
verification_criteria: Define strict JSON schema tracking stage_id, phase_id, subphase_id, status, timestamps, and git SHA hashes
Implement automated state locking ensuring Subphase N cannot start until Subphase N-1 verification criteria pass

subphases.title: Global Engineering Contract (contracts/ENGINEERING_CONTRACT.md)
verification_criteria: Codify Clean Architecture guidelines, state management invariants, and error-handling hierarchies
Define strict rules for zero-network calls: eliminate standard networking packages (http, dio)

subphases.title: Static Analysis, Formatting & Git Hook Gates
verification_criteria: Configure analysis_options.yaml with pedantic rules
Set up pre-commit and pre-push hooks via PowerShell to execute linting, format verification, and unit test suites

subphases.title: Quality Gate & Static Analysis Workflow
verification_criteria: Define .github/workflows/quality-gate.yml running lint checks, formatting validation, and security credential scanning
Enforce minimum 85% domain coverage gate

subphases.title: Android Matrix Build & Artifact Packaging
verification_criteria: Define .github/workflows/build-android.yml on ubuntu-latest
Configure Gradle cache optimization, split per-ABI APK builds, and unsigned App Bundle (app-release.aab) compilation
Configure automated artifact compression and upload with customizable retention periods

subphases.title: iOS Runner & Unsigned IPA Archival Workflow
verification_criteria: Define .github/workflows/build-ios.yml running on macos-latest
Automate CocoaPods caching, workspace generation, flutter build ios --no-codesign execution, and payload packaging into unsigned .ipa artifact

stages.name: High-Performance Vector Generator & Payload Serialization Engine

subphases.title: Universal Text, URI & Contact (vCard 4.0) Serializers
verification_criteria: Implement RFC-compliant serializers for URLs, plain text, and vCard 4.0
Handle multi-line addresses, photo base64 sanitization, and UTF-8 encoding
Build deterministic unit tests covering edge-case UTF-8 characters and whitespace boundaries

subphases.title: Network & Infrastructure Serializers (Wi-Fi, Geo, Calendar)
verification_criteria: Implement Wi-Fi syntax serialization (WIFI:T:WPA;S:MySSID;P:MyPassword;;) with special-character escaping
Build iCalendar (vCalendar) and standard RFC-5870 Geolocation URI schemes
Unit tests verify parameter escaping and parsing round-trips

subphases.title: Secure Authentication & Web3 Serializers (TOTP, Crypto)
verification_criteria: Implement RFC 6238 TOTP URI schema (otpauth://totp/...) with algorithm selection (SHA1, SHA256, SHA512), digits, and periods
Build BIP-0021 (Bitcoin), EIP-681 (Ethereum), and Solana URI encoders with address checksum verification

subphases.title: QR Matrix Generation & Mask Pattern Optimizers
verification_criteria: Implement QR matrix calculation covering versions 1 through 40 with automatic version-growth selection
Program automatic mask pattern evaluations (Penalty scores 0 through 7) to ensure optical scanner contrast stability

subphases.title: Dynamic Error Correction Code (ECC) Allocator
verification_criteria: Implement Reed-Solomon polynomial division supporting ECC levels L (7%), M (15%), Q (25%), and H (30%)
Build auto-downgrading and auto-upgrading ECC strategies based on total payload size and export target

phases.name: Visual Styler, Canvas Renderer & Vector Exporters

subphases.title: Custom Module, Eye & Gradient Styler Engine
verification_criteria: Build a custom rendering engine supporting rounded modules, circular dots, custom outer/inner eye corners
Implement error-tolerance safe margins (quiet zones) preventing custom visuals from breaking scan contrast

subphases.title: Central Embedded Logo & Clipping Mask Engine
verification_criteria: Implement logo injection logic enforcing ECC Level H (30% redundancy) and capping embedded image coverage to < 20%
Build auto-clipping masks to prevent module overlapping under transparent logo bounds

subphases.title: High-Res Export Pipelines (SVG, PDF, PNG, WEBP)
verification_criteria: Build raw XML-based SVG generator generating crisp vectors without external raster dependencies
Implement high-DPI rasterization exporting to PNG (1024x1024, 2048x2048, 4096x4096) and vector PDF with print-ready bleed markers

stages.name: Zero-Trust Optical Scanner & Sandboxed Action Hub

subphases.title: Camera Feed Lifecycle & Viewport Matrix
verification_criteria: Implement low-latency camera controller initialization with automatic lifecycle binding
Configure hardware-accelerated viewport targeting, pinch-to-zoom controls, auto-exposure locks, and torch toggle

subphases.title: Dual-Engine Optical Detection Integration
verification_criteria: Integrate Google ML Kit Barcode Scanning (Android/iOS) and Apple Vision Framework pipelines
Build a continuous frame-buffer pipeline running at 60 FPS without dropping frames or triggering GC pauses

subphases.title: Static Image & Gallery Decoder
verification_criteria: Build native image picker integration with background isolate decoding for user-selected photos
Implement automated image pre-processing (contrast maximization, grayscaling, inverted QR code detection)

subphases.title: Malicious URL Parser & Domain Inspector
verification_criteria: Build a local heuristic analyzer detecting homograph/punycode attacks, IP-based destinations, and high-risk URL schemes
Display a pre-flight security interstitial presenting full domain paths and destination protocols

subphases.title: Privacy Tracker Stripper Engine
verification_criteria: Implement automated query parameter sanitization stripping tracking identifiers (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, msclkid, ref_, mc_eid)
Add automatic shortlink expansion preview warnings for links masked by common redirect providers

subphases.title: Native Intent Dispatcher
verification_criteria: Implement secure platform channels triggering native actions: Wi-Fi connection prompts, contact saving, calendar injection

phases.name: Offline Encrypted Scan History & Batch Management

subphases.title: Encrypted Storage Layer (SQLCipher / Hive AES)
verification_criteria: Implement a zero-trust local database encrypted via AES-256 backed by Keystore/Keychain
Design relational models for scans, tags, favorites, and metadata timestamps

subphases.title: High-Volume Batch Scanning Mode
verification_criteria: Build continuous scanning capturing successive codes with haptic/audio feedback without dismissing viewfinder
Implement automatic deduplication logic (debouncing redundant frames within a 1.5-second sliding window)

subphases.title: Offline Search, Filtering & Data Export
verification_criteria: Implement full-text search across scanned payloads, date-range filters, and categorization tags
Build batch export mechanisms outputting to structured CSV, JSON, and formatted plain text

stages.name: Air-Gapped Optical Data Transfer (Visual ZeroSync Protocol)

subphases.title: Binary Payload Compression Pipeline
verification_criteria: Implement in-memory compression utilizing zlib/gzip and brotli with automated compression ratio evaluation
Define binary payload boundaries with maximum single-frame limits (<= 450 bytes per module grid)

subphases.title: Transport Frame Serialization & Header Definition
verification_criteria: Design packed binary header: Session ID (4B) + Total Chunks (2B) + Chunk Index (2B) + CRC32 (4B) + MIME Flag (1B)
Build unit tests verifying header bit-packing, big-endian byte-order alignment, and payload slicing accuracy

subphases.title: Checksum & Integrity Layer
verification_criteria: Implement continuous CRC32 validation per chunk alongside SHA-256 whole-file cryptographic checksum verification upon assembly

phases.name: Erasure Resilient Streaming (Fountain / Luby Transform Implementation)

subphases.title: Luby Transform (LT) / RaptorQ Mathematical Engine
verification_criteria: Implement degree-distribution soliton transforms generating rateless recovery droplets
Enable receiver to rebuild original file using any N + epsilon distinct valid packets without synchronized frame starts

subphases.title: Dynamic Frame Rate Throttling & Visual Modulation
verification_criteria: Implement high-speed canvas animation loop (5 to 15 FPS) with user-configurable frame intervals
Add automatic contrast enhancement (black/white edge sharpening, dynamic screen brightness override to 100%)

subphases.title: Chunk Accumulator & Deduplication Engine
verification_criteria: Build asynchronous frame ingest buffer that identifies incoming Session ID markers, discards duplicates, and caches out-of-order frames
Implement memory-efficient sparse array storage to eliminate allocation overhead during scanning

subphases.title: Real-Time Stream Progress & Missing Block Matrix
verification_criteria: Build observable progress state stream: percentage completed, missing chunk indexes, transfer speed (KB/s), estimated time remaining
Provide visual missing-block heatmaps on screen to assist user in maintaining optimal camera distance

subphases.title: Decompression, Verification & File System Deserialization
verification_criteria: Automate stream completion triggers: run whole-payload SHA-256 validation against original header signatures
Decompress payload bytes and safely write to sandboxed application storage with MIME-type based extension reconstruction

stages.name: Adaptive UI/UX Design, Tablet Layouts & System Performance

subphases.title: Design Tokens & Visual Theme Engine
verification_criteria: Establish cohesive Dark/Light themes with high-contrast UI modes, strictly typed typography, custom iconography
Enforce zero runtime UI thread jank through pure stateless/const widget structures

subphases.title: Large Screen, Foldable & Tablet Split-Pane Layouts
verification_criteria: Implement LayoutBuilder / NavigationSplitView architecture: adapt seamlessly between single-column mobile and dual-pane tablet
Maintain persistent camera scanner preview on primary pane while rendering real-time history or inspection data on secondary pane

subphases.title: Haptic Feedback, Audio Chimes & Micro-Interactions
verification_criteria: Integrate platform-specific haptic feedback patterns using native vibrating actuators
Implement synthetic, low-latency audio chimes for successful batch scans with muting controls

subphases.title: Camera Sensor Throttle & Thermal Management
verification_criteria: Implement automated camera frame downsampling when device core temperatures rise
Build inactivity sleep timers that suspend image stream after 3 minutes of idle camera operation

subphases.title: Memory Leak Auditing & Garbage Collection Profiling
verification_criteria: Audit raw byte buffers, native image streams, and Dart typed-data allocations to eliminate object retention
Implement deterministic disposal routines for controllers, stream subscriptions, and native bindings

subphases.title: Screen Reader & Accessible Navigation Semantics
verification_criteria: Wrap custom scanner overlays, QR matrices, and animated transfer components with explicit Semantics widgets
Ensure full compliance with WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios across light and dark color schemes

subphases.title: Internationalization Architecture
verification_criteria: Scaffold .arb translation structures supporting multi-lingual UI (LTR and RTL languages)
Externalize all hardcoded strings into strongly-typed localizations

stages.name: End-to-End Optical Loopback Testing, Cryptographic Auditing & Release

subphases.title: Screen-to-Camera Optical Loopback Simulation
verification_criteria: Build integration test harness taking output frames from generator, feeding directly into scanner pipeline, verifying byte-for-byte fidelity across all data types

subphases.title: Packet-Drop, Noise & Blur Fault-Tolerance Testing
verification_criteria: Stress-test transfer engine with simulated noise: random chunk drop rates (10% - 40%), synthetic motion blur, angled perspective distortions
Verify Fountain/RaptorQ reassembly recovers complete payloads without data corruption

subphases.title: Air-Gap Verification & Network Isolation Audit
verification_criteria: Audit compiled application manifests to verify absence of unnecessary networking or tracking permissions
Run static binary analysis verifying no dynamic network code injection vectors exist in dependencies

subphases.title: Cryptographic Storage & Fuzz Testing
verification_criteria: Execute payload fuzzing on QR scanner parser with malformed strings, oversized byte sequences, invalid UTF-8
Verify key derivation, AES-256 database encryption, and secure memory wiping

subphases.title: ProGuard, R8 & Symbol Obfuscation
verification_criteria: Configure Android R8/ProGuard shrinking rules and iOS symbol stripping to minimize binary size while preserving ML Kit reflection boundaries

subphases.title: Automated Release Artifact Build
verification_criteria: Execute GitHub Actions production pipelines to build optimized, signed release artifacts: Universal APK, Split APKs, AAB, and iOS unsigned .ipa
Generate and publish SHA-256 checksum manifests alongside build artifacts for provenance verification
